correctness.rationale: For n>=5 a convex C_n layer restricts dual mutual-visibility M to empty or one adjacent pair for n=5,6, while no occupied layer exists for n>=7. Convex C_n square K_2 subgraphs constrain a pair in distinct layers to antipodal offset three when n=6 and rule it out at n=5; third occupied layer contradicts pairwise offsets. Compatible four-sets remain valid with arbitrarily many extra K_m layers, so polynomial 1+nm z² + 6*C(m,2)z⁴ for n=6, 1+5m z² at n=5, 1 afterward. For n=6 every layer is tiled by one of two horizontal perfect matchings, and pairing opposite phases in three edge types yields sharp 3ceil(m/2) classes and exact factorial optimal partition counts. Independent exhaustive dual-set enumeration n=5 m=1,2; n=6 m=1,2; n=7 m=1 matched the formulas; not an infinite proof.
